description: Firebase rules that leave the data open, in all three rules files a Firebase project deploys. firestore.rules: a root wildcard with public read (critical) and any-signed-in-user write through a helper function (high), plus open update/delete on a named collection (critical); its owner-scoped /users block cannot help, because Firestore rules are OR-ed. storage.rules: the legacy console default, any signed-in user on the whole bucket (high). database.rules.json: root ".read": true (critical) and root ".write": "auth != null" (high); Realtime Database rules cascade, so the per-user rule beneath cannot narrow either. cms/database.rules.json (reduced from alexabbott/firebase-cms): a locked root, but ".write": true on /admins (critical) while every other node's write checks root.child('admins/'+auth.uid), so anyone can make themselves an admin.
